meaning: زود قضاوت کردن، زودتر از موقع نتیجه گرفتن

examples.english: You should stop and think before jumping to conclusions.
examples.persian: باید قبل از زود قضاوت کردن، توقف کنی و فکر کنی.

miniContext: If you jump to conclusions when you are trying to interpret a gesture, you may misinterpret what it means.

meaning: تفسیر کردن، معنی خاصی برایش قائل شدن

examples.english: Is it difficult to interpret someone's body language if you don't know them well?
examples.persian: آیا تفسیر زبان بدن کسی که خوب نمی‌شناسی‌اش سخت است؟

miniContext: Is it difficult to interpret someone's body language if you don't know them well?

meaning: حرکت بدنی که معنایی خاص را می‌رساند

examples.english: I use hand gestures a lot. Sometimes it annoys people.
examples.persian: من زیاد از حرکات دست استفاده می‌کنم. بعضی وقت‌ها مردم را آزار می‌دهد.

miniContext: I use hand gestures a lot. Sometimes it annoys people.

examples.english: Do you think you are good at making eye contact with people?
examples.persian: فکر می‌کنی در برقراری تماس چشمی با مردم خوب هستی؟

miniContext: People who look away to avoid eye contact may not necessarily be lying.

examples.english: If you go red, does it mean you're angry? - No, not necessarily.
examples.persian: اگر سرخ شوی یعنی عصبانی هستی؟ نه، نه لزوماً.

miniContext: People who look away to avoid eye contact may not necessarily be lying: they could just be very shy.

examples.english: We need to observe a combination of behaviour.
examples.persian: باید ترکیبی از رفتارها را مشاهده کنیم.

miniContext: To understand body language, we need to observe a combination of behaviour.

examples.english: The increase is the result of a combination of different factors.
examples.persian: این افزایش نتیجه ترکیبی از عوامل مختلف است.

miniContext: The increase in the number of students is the result of a combination of different factors.

meaning: مراقب چیزی یا کسی بودن، به دنبال آن گشتن

examples.english: With lying, look out for any of these signs.
examples.persian: در مورد دروغ گفتن، مراقب هر کدام از این نشانه‌ها باش.

miniContext: With lying, for example, look out for any of these: avoiding eye contact, sweating a lot, going red.

examples.english: It was so hot in the room, I was starting to sweat.
examples.persian: اتاق آنقدر گرم بود که داشتم عرق می‌کردم.

miniContext: It was so hot in the room, I was starting to sweat.

examples.english: She goes red all the time.

miniContext: She goes red all the time.

examples.english: I constantly move my feet when I'm nervous - I can't stop it.
examples.persian: وقتی عصبی هستم دائماً پاهایم را تکان می‌دهم، نمی‌توانم جلویش را بگیرم.

miniContext: I constantly move my feet when I'm nervous - I can't stop it.

examples.english: It can be dangerous to make generalizations about the meaning of gestures.
examples.persian: کلی‌گویی درباره معنای حرکات بدنی می‌تواند خطرناک باشد.

miniContext: Hand and body gestures can mean different things in different countries, so it can be dangerous to make generalizations about their meaning.

examples.english: A clenched fist often shows anger.
examples.persian: مشت گره‌کرده معمولاً نشانه خشم است.

miniContext: A clenched fist often shows anger.

examples.english: If you say negative things about his work, he becomes a bit defensive.
examples.persian: اگر درباره کارش حرف منفی بزنی، کمی حالت تدافعی می‌گیرد.

miniContext: If you say negative things about his work, he becomes a bit defensive.

examples.english: Certain gestures clearly signal that they fancy each other.
examples.persian: برخی حرکات به‌وضوح نشان می‌دهند که آن‌ها به هم علاقه دارند.

miniContext: Certain gestures between couples clearly signal that they fancy each other.

examples.english: Even when he's angry, he doesn't really display any signs of emotion.
examples.persian: حتی وقتی عصبانی است، واقعاً هیچ نشانه‌ای از احساساتش بروز نمی‌دهد.

miniContext: Even when he's angry, he doesn't really display any signs of emotion.

meaning: به کسی جذب شدن، از کسی خوشش آمدن (عامیانه)

miniContext: Women who fancy someone often touch their hair.
